headline: Growth keeps compounding as margins hold near highs
summary_short: AppLovin grew Q2 FY2026 revenue to $1.92B, up 52.8% y/y and 4.4% q/q, while net income rose 54.5% y/y to $1.27B (diluted EPS $3.76) as free cash flow reached $863M and Adjusted EBITDA margin held near 84%.
summary_long: Revenue grew 52.8% y/y and 4.4% q/q to $1.92B, with net income up 54.5% y/y to $1.27B and diluted EPS of $3.76. Adjusted EBITDA rose 58% y/y to $1.61B (84% margin) and free cash flow was $863M. The release contains no MD&A or segment commentary explaining the growth; the modest q/q gross-margin compression (~70bp) is fully explained by cost of revenue growing 10.9% q/q against 4.4% revenue growth. AppLovin repurchased $551.3M of stock in the quarter, ending with $3.05B cash and $3.52B long-term debt (roughly flat). Management issued 3Q26 guidance of $2.055-2.085B revenue and $1.71-1.74B Adjusted EBITDA (83% margin) — a first-time guide for that quarter, not a change to a prior range.
